name: Tidy Byte Tools
description: Small tools that clean up messy data. Each one does one job and does it well.

tools.name: PDF Table Pull
tools.what_it_does: Pull tables out of PDFs into Excel, CSV, or JSON.
tools.summary: Copying tables out of a PDF by hand is slow, and pasting them into Excel often wrecks the columns. This tool finds the tables and saves clean rows.

tools.name: Doc to Markdown
tools.what_it_does: Turn PDFs, Word files, and web pages into clean Markdown.
tools.summary: Get Markdown you can use in notes, docs, or AI apps. Tables stay as Markdown tables. The paid version also writes chunks for AI search.

tools.name: CSV & spreadsheet cleanup
tools.what_it_does: Clean messy CSV and Excel files: dates, phones, emails, and duplicates.
tools.summary: Got a sheet full of extra spaces, mixed date styles, and repeat rows? These tools tidy the file and give you a clean table back.

tools.name: JSON Shaper
tools.what_it_does: Turn messy notes, CSV, and Markdown tables into clean JSON.
tools.summary: Free converters do well with neat CSV. JSON Shaper is for the messy stuff: pasted notes, key: value lists, and tables.

tools.name: Lead Sheet Fixer
tools.what_it_does: Clean a lead list: fix phones, check emails, and merge duplicates.
tools.summary: Clean the lead list you already have. Phones are formatted, bad emails are flagged, names can be split, and duplicate rows can be merged.

tools.name: Phone Number Validator
tools.what_it_does: Check phone numbers and format them as E.164, in bulk, offline.
tools.summary: See if each number is valid and write it in three common formats. The tool also shows country, line type, area, and time zone. It works offline and never calls or texts anyone.

tools.name: Data Cleanup Bundle
tools.what_it_does: Three desktop tools together: PDF tables, sheet cleanup, and JSON Shaper.
tools.summary: Get pdf-table-pull, sheet-scrub, and json-shaper in one purchase. Bought one by one they cost at least $26. The bundle is $19, so you save $7.

tools.name: Broken Link Checker
tools.what_it_does: Check a list of links for status codes, redirects, and broken pages.
tools.summary: Paste a list, give a sitemap, or scan pages for their links. Get a clear report of what works, what is broken, and where redirects end up.

tools.name: Server Pulse
tools.what_it_does: Get a Discord alert when a website or server goes down.
tools.summary: Server Pulse watches a site or server and sends a Discord message if it goes down. It can also post Stripe and PayPal donation alerts to Discord.

tools.name: Markdown Chunker for RAG
tools.what_it_does: Split Markdown into chunks for AI search, with heading paths kept.
tools.summary: Split a Markdown file by heading so each chunk stays on one topic. Code blocks and tables stay whole when they fit. Each chunk keeps its heading path and line numbers. This is plain code, not an AI model, so the same file always gives the same chunks.

tools.name: GIF Forge
tools.what_it_does: Turn a folder of videos into small, sharp GIFs, offline.
tools.summary: Drop in a folder of clips and get a folder of small, sharp, looping GIFs. It can also remove solid image backgrounds, all on your computer.

tools.name: n8n Data Cleanup Pack
tools.what_it_does: 9 n8n workflows for messy CSVs, leads, invoices, sheets, and uptime alerts.
tools.summary: Import a file, pick your logins, and run. These workflows clean messy data in n8n, using only the nodes that come with n8n.

tools.name: n8n Cleanup Sampler
tools.what_it_does: 2 free n8n workflows from the Data Cleanup Pack: CSV cleanup and uptime alerts.
tools.summary: Try two workflows for free before you buy the full pack. Import a file, follow the setup note inside, and run. No logins are stored in the files.

tools.name: csv-char-fix
tools.what_it_does: Fix weird characters like Ã© and â€™ in CSV and text files.
tools.summary: Did an export turn José into JosÃ© or it's into itâ€™s? This small script puts the text back the way it should be and saves the file so Excel shows accents right.

tools.name: csv-split
tools.what_it_does: Split a big CSV into smaller files. Every new file keeps the header.
tools.summary: Use it when a CSV is too big for Excel, too big to upload, or when you want one file per group, like one file per state.

tools.name: Regex Pack for Messy Data
tools.what_it_does: 49 ready-to-use regex patterns for emails, phones, dates, money, and more.
tools.summary: Copy a pattern into your tool, or use the small helper script to check or fix a CSV column. Every pattern comes with examples that are tested in Python and JavaScript.

tools.name: CSV Skills for Claude Code
tools.what_it_does: 4 Claude Code skills that profile, diff, fix, and split CSV files on your computer.
tools.summary: Claude runs a small, tested script and reads the short result, instead of loading a big CSV into the chat line by line. Your data stays on your computer.

tools.name: HTML Table Extractor
tools.what_it_does: Pull tables from web pages into CSV and JSON.
tools.summary: Reads HTML tables from a page or pasted HTML. Keeps merged cells, handles more than one table on a page, and saves CSV. Honest about tables that only appear after JavaScript runs.

tools.name: LLM Token Counter
tools.what_it_does: Count tokens and estimate cost for GPT, Claude, and Gemini.
tools.summary: Counts tokens offline for OpenAI models and estimates Claude and Gemini. Uses public list prices. No API key. Paste text or add file links.

tools.name: JSON to CSV Converter
tools.what_it_does: Flatten nested JSON or JSON Lines into a CSV table.
tools.summary: Turn nested JSON into a flat table for Excel and Google Sheets. You pick how lists are handled.

tools.name: CSV Encoding Fixer
tools.what_it_does: Fix broken characters in CSV files and split large files.
tools.summary: Fixes garbled letters such as Ã© instead of é, then saves clean UTF-8 that opens right in Excel. Can also split a large file and keep the header on every part.
